02

What am I seeing?

A closer look at the sound.

The Log-Mel spectrogram breaks audio into tiny overlapping slices, then measures energy across Mel-spaced frequency bands. Mel spacing gives more room to the pitches we hear most clearly.

WAVEFORM→FFT→MEL FILTERS→dB

THE SHORT VERSION

Log-Mel, in a nutshell.

Audio is framed into 2,048-sample windows with a Hann taper, transformed with an FFT, then pooled through 64 overlapping triangular filters spaced on the HTK Mel scale. The displayed color is 10 × log₁₀ of each band's power.

Frames arrive every 10 ms. With a 2,048-sample window, each frame covers about 46 ms at 44.1 kHz. All processing happens in your browser using an AudioWorklet.
